title: Uniformizer association and fraction-field existence in a DVR
statement: For a domain DVR [lem-weil-pbc-dvr-unit-times-uniformizer-power] with a nonzero maximal ideal m and a fixed fraction field, generators of m are associated and every nonzero fraction is a unit times an integral power of any generator.

proof.text: Use the DVR irreducible-uniformizer equivalence and the fraction-field zpow existence theorem; generators of the same maximal ideal are associated irreducibles.

lean.statement: theorem extension_integers_dvr_factorization (E : Type*) [Field E] (O : Subring E) (m : Ideal O) (hDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing O) (_hm0 : m ≠ ⊥) (hmax : m.IsMaximal) (hfrac : IsFractionRing O E) (_hgen : ∃ π : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m) : (∀ π π' : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m → Ideal.span ({π'} : Set O) = m → ∃ v : Oˣ, π' = (v : O) * π) ∧ (∀ π : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m → ∀ x : Eˣ, ∃ p : Oˣ × ℤ, (x : E) = ((p.1 : O) : E) * (π : E) ^ p.2)
